stories.title: Five Buss siblings 'united' in selling Lakers shares
stories.summary: Five of the six members of the Buss trust say they are "united" in their intention to sell their remaining shares in the Lakers, despite pushback from Jeanie Buss.

stories.title: Multiple brawls mar Saints-Cowboys joint practice
stories.summary: The Cowboys and Saints had so many fights during their joint session Tuesday that the coaches of each team discussed whether they needed to cancel the practice.

stories.title: LIV players mixed after meeting proposed investor
stories.summary: With LIV Golf's future still murky, players met with CEO Scott O'Neil and the league's proposed new investor Tuesday for about 50 minutes, and while some claimed progress was made, others were noncommittal.

stories.title: Marte in Phoenix after no-show for knee testing
stories.summary: Ketel Marte, who was placed on the restricted list after failing to show up to Monday's game, has traveled back to Phoenix for tests on his left knee, D-backs manager Torey Lovullo said.

stories.title: Dodgers put Diaz on IL, watch Ohtani throw bullpen
stories.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers on Tuesday put Edwin Diaz, who is 2-2 with an 11.85 ERA and seven saves in 11 opportunities in 16 games, on the injured list because of inflammation in the right side of his neck, while Shohei Ohtani threw another bullpen session.
